headline: Interviewed Jorge Allen, a finalist for Salem's superintendent job, on budgets, equity, and the new high school.
summary: Dr. Jorge Allen answered questions from committee members during his interview for the superintendent job. Topics included budgeting, family engagement, support for students facing barriers, and plans for the new high school.
